info.title: Universal Scheduling Protocol (USP) REST API
info.description: The Universal Scheduling Protocol (USP) enables consumer platforms and AI agents to discover, check availability of, and book time-based services from businesses. This OpenAPI specification defines the REST binding for all USP operations.

tags.name: Availability
tags.description: Availability query and optional hold operations. Hold and release endpoints require the business to advertise holds: true in the dev.usp.services.availability capability.

USP-Agent.name: USP-Agent
USP-Agent.description: Platform profile URI for capability negotiation (Standalone Mode). RFC 8941 Dictionary Structured Field syntax. The business fetches this URI to determine the capability intersection. Required in Standalone Mode; omit in UCP-Native Mode.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: UUID v4 for idempotency of state-modifying operations.

PaginationRequest.description: Cursor-based pagination request fields. See Section 9.1.2 of the USP specification.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from the previous response. Omit on the first request.

limit.description: Requested page size. Businesses MAY apply a lower or upper cap.

Pagination.description: Cursor-based pagination state. See Section 9.1.2 of the USP specification.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page. Pass this value as the cursor field in the next request body. null when there are no more pages.

has_more.description: true if additional pages exist beyond this one; false on the last page.

id.description: Unique service identifier, scoped to the business. The composite key (business_id, id) is globally unique.

business_id.description: Identifier of the business that owns this service. Populated by the provider in API responses. Together with id, forms the globally unique composite key.

provider.description: Inline business metadata for display without a separate profile fetch. Aligns with UCP seller object.

links.description: Typed links to policy and information pages.

type.description: Link type. Well-known values: privacy_policy, terms_of_service, refund_policy, cancellation_policy, faq.

name.description: Human-readable display name for the service.

oneOf.description: Structured description with multiple format variants. Aligns with UCP Description type.

plain.description: Plain text content. Always required as the universal fallback.

html.description: HTML-formatted content. Platforms MUST sanitize before rendering.

description.description: Service description. Accepts either a plain string or a structured Description object with plain, markdown, and html variants.

type.description: Service vertical. One of the core verticals (appointment, group, reservation, rental) or a vendor-defined vertical using reverse-domain notation (e.g., com.wix.services.courses). Platforms encountering an unrecognized vertical SHOULD fall back to appointment semantics.

locations.description: Physical or virtual locations where the service is offered.

capacity.description: Required for group and reservation types.

waitlist.description: Whether waitlist is enabled when slots are full.

media.description: Service media items (images, videos). Replaces the previous images field. Aligns with UCP media model.

type.description: Media format type. Well-known values: image, video.

role.description: Display role: hero (primary banner), gallery (additional), thumbnail (small preview).

images.description: Deprecated. Alias for media for backward compatibility. If both images and media are present, media takes precedence.

rating.description: Aggregate service rating. Aligns with UCP rating object.

scale_min.description: Minimum value on the rating scale (e.g., 1 for 1-5 stars).

scale_max.description: Maximum value on the rating scale (e.g., 5 for 5-star).

count.description: Number of reviews contributing to the rating.

status.description: Service lifecycle status. active: bookable (default). suspended: temporarily unavailable. archived: no longer offered.

handle.description: URL-friendly slug for the service (e.g., womens-haircut-style).

url.description: Canonical service page URL on the business's website.

tags.description: Freeform tags for categorization and search.

metadata.description: Business-defined custom data extending the standard service model. Platforms SHOULD pass through opaquely.

links.description: Typed links to policy and information pages specific to this service. Platforms SHOULD surface these during the booking flow. Well-known types: cancellation_policy, rescheduling_policy, terms_of_service, privacy_policy, waiver, faq.

type.description: Link type. Well-known values: cancellation_policy, rescheduling_policy, terms_of_service, privacy_policy, waiver, faq.

LocalizedFields.description: Per-locale overrides for human-readable text fields. Keys are IETF BCP 47 language tags.

name.description: Per-locale overrides for the service name.

description.description: Per-locale overrides for the service description.

category_name.description: Per-locale overrides for the category name.

Duration.description: Duration configuration. Provide exactly one of fixed, range, or undetermined.

fixed.description: ISO 8601 duration. Required if neither range nor undetermined is present.

range.description: Required if neither fixed nor undetermined is present. Buyer selects a duration within this range.

undetermined.description: Set to true when the service has no meaningful duration to display (e.g., consultations, custom quotes). Must not be combined with fixed or range.

buffer_before.description: ISO 8601 non-bookable prep time before the service.

buffer_after.description: ISO 8601 non-bookable cleanup time after the service.

amount.description: Price in minor currency units (e.g. 7500 = $75.00). Required when model is fixed, hourly, or per_person. Must not be present when model is free.

price_range.description: Displayable price range in minor currency units (same currency as pricing.currency). Recommended when model is variable, hourly, or per_person so platforms can show a price range without querying availability. Aligns with UCP price_range.

min.description: Minimum price in minor currency units.

max.description: Maximum price in minor currency units.

refundable.description: Whether the deposit is refundable upon free-window cancellation.

virtual_provider.description: Platform name (e.g. Zoom, Google Meet). Relevant for virtual and hybrid channels.

free_cancellation_until.description: ISO 8601 duration before service start for free cancellation.

late_cancellation_fee.description: Fee in minor currency units for late cancellation.

no_cancellation_after.description: ISO 8601 duration after which cancellation is no longer permitted.

free_reschedule_until.description: ISO 8601 duration before start for free rescheduling.

fee.description: Fee in minor currency units for rescheduling outside the free window.
Fixed fee in minor currency units.

fee_percentage.description: Percentage of service price charged as no-show fee.

grace_period.description: ISO 8601 duration after scheduled start before marking as no-show.

slot_interval.description: ISO 8601 interval at which slots are generated.

confirmation_mode.description: auto: confirmed immediately. manual: requires business approval.

requires_payment.description: Whether this service requires any payment.

payment_timing.description: Required when requires_payment is true. Must not be present when requires_payment is false.

AvailabilityHint.description: Approximate availability summary for agent-assisted discovery. Not a substitute for real-time availability queries.

summary.description: Natural-language description of near-term availability, aimed at AI agents.

generated_at.description: When this hint was generated. Hints older than 6 hours should be treated with lower confidence.

next_available_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD date of the next day with known availability.

callback_url.description: Webhook URL where catalog change events are delivered. Must be HTTPS.

categories.description: Category IDs to receive events for. If omitted, receives events for all categories.

events.description: Event types to subscribe to. If omitted, defaults to all service.* events.

id.description: Unique slot identifier, opaque to the platform.

service_id.description: The service this slot belongs to.

start.description: RFC 3339 start time of the slot.

end.description: RFC 3339 end time of the slot.

state.description: available: open for booking. limited: low remaining capacity. waitlist: fully booked but waitlist enabled.

capacity.description: Present for group and reservation types.

location.description: Specific location for this slot, when a service is offered at multiple locations.

pricing.description: Slot-specific pricing that overrides service-level pricing. Used for peak/off-peak or demand-based pricing.

spots.description: Number of spots held. For group and reservation types, this is the number of capacity units reserved.

expires_at.description: RFC 3339 expiration time. Hold TTL is typically 5-10 minutes.

status.description: active: hold is in effect. expired: TTL elapsed. released: explicitly released. converted: converted to a booking.

id.description: Unique booking identifier, generated by the business.

service_name.description: Service display name, captured at booking time. Does not change if the service name is later updated.

recipient.description: The person receiving the service, when different from the buyer. When absent, the buyer is the recipient.

resources.description: Specific resources assigned to this booking.

confirmation_mode.description: Reflects the service's confirmation policy at booking time.

actions.description: Ordered array of pending tasks the buyer must complete. Must be present and non-empty when status is requires_action; must be absent or empty otherwise.

booking_url.description: Stable URL where the buyer can view and manage this booking. Used in confirmation emails, calendar events, and buyer portals.

dispute.description: Present when a payment dispute has been opened for this booking.

messages.description: Soft messages from the business providing context about the booking state. Informational only; do not block booking creation.

cancellation.description: Present when the booking has been canceled.

canceled_by.description: Who initiated the cancellation (e.g. buyer, business).

fee.description: Cancellation fee in minor currency units.

refund_amount.description: Refund amount in minor currency units.

expires_at.description: Present for pending and requires_action bookings. If not resolved by this time, the booking transitions to canceled.

BookingPayment.description: Payment state on the booking. Present when the service requires_payment is true and payment_timing is at_booking or deposit_required. Omitted when requires_payment is false.

amount.description: Service fee in minor currency units, before tax. Does not include tax_amount.

amount_due.description: Amount due now in minor currency units.

tax_amount.description: Tax amount in minor currency units. When present, total charged = amount + tax_amount. Must use the same currency as amount.

deposit_amount.description: Deposit amount when timing is deposit_required.

transaction_id.description: Transaction ID from the payment provider, set after confirm-payment.

order_reference.description: External order ID from the checkout system.

PaymentContext.description: Universal payment handoff object nested inside a payment action. Contains everything a checkout system needs to process payment. The payment expiry deadline is carried on the action's expires_at field.

amount_due.description: Amount to collect in minor currency units.

Action.description: A pending task the buyer must complete before a booking can be confirmed.

continue_url.description: Business-hosted URL for completing this specific action.

payment_context.description: Payment handoff object. Must be present when type is payment (Standalone Mode only).

Message.title: Message
Message.description: Structured message for errors, warnings, or informational notices on any USP response. Aligned with the UCP message model.

code.description: Machine-readable code identifying the message type (e.g., slot_unavailable, service_suspended). Standard codes are defined in §9.4; freeform codes are permitted.

severity.description: Reflects the resource state and recommended action. 'recoverable': platform can resolve by modifying inputs and retrying. 'requires_buyer_input': buyer must provide information before proceeding. 'requires_buyer_review': buyer must authorize before proceeding due to policy or regulatory rules. 'unrecoverable': no valid resource exists; retry with new resource or inputs.

path.description: RFC 9535 JSONPath to the field this message relates to (e.g., $.services[0].pricing).

Dispute.title: Dispute
Dispute.description: A payment dispute (chargeback) opened against a booking. Opening a dispute does NOT change payment.status — the payment remains paid. Status MAY change to refunded or partially_refunded only if the dispute resolves in the buyer's favor.

reason.description: Machine-readable reason code. Well-known values: service_not_provided, quality_issue, unauthorized, duplicate.

opened_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp of when the dispute was opened.

resolved_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp of when the dispute was resolved. Present only when status is resolved_buyer or resolved_business.

PostPaymentReturnRequest.title: PostPaymentReturnRequest
PostPaymentReturnRequest.description: Applicable when checkout_systems: redirect is in use. Instructs the business where to redirect the buyer's browser after payment completes, is cancelled, or is abandoned. The platform SHOULD always include this field on the redirect path — without it, the platform cannot predict or control where the buyer lands after the payment flow. The business MUST issue an HTTP GET redirect to url (with all params appended as URL query parameters) in both terminal outcomes: payment completed and payment cancelled/abandoned.

url.description: The platform's return URL. The business MUST redirect the buyer's browser to this URL (via HTTP GET) after payment completes, is cancelled, or is abandoned, appending any params as query parameters.

params.description: Query parameter key-value pairs the business MUST append verbatim to url when issuing the return redirect. Keys and values are opaque to the business — the platform uses them to carry whatever correlation state it needs (e.g. a token generated before the booking request) so it can map the returning buyer back to its session.

service_id.description: The service the buyer is waitlisted for.

preferred_slots.description: Preferred time windows. If omitted, the buyer accepts any available slot.

time_of_day.description: Preferred time of day (e.g. morning, afternoon, evening).

position.description: Current position in the waitlist queue (1-based).

offered_slot.description: The slot being offered. Present when status is offered.

offer_expires_at.description: Expiration time for the current offer. Present when status is offered.

ResourceRequirement.description: Defines what staff, rooms, or equipment are needed for a service.

name.description: Human-readable label for this resource type (e.g. 'Stylist').

selectable.description: Whether the buyer can choose a specific resource during booking. When true, options must be populated.

options.description: Available resource instances. Required when selectable is true.

type.description: URI reference identifying the problem type.

title.description: Short, human-readable summary of the problem.

detail.description: Human-readable explanation specific to this occurrence.

instance.description: URI reference identifying the specific occurrence.

SigningKey.title: SigningKey
SigningKey.description: A public key in JWK format (RFC 7517) used to verify HTTP Message Signatures (RFC 9421) on webhook payloads. The keyid parameter in the Signature-Input header MUST match the kid of one of the signing_keys in the business profile.

kid.description: Key ID. Matched against the keyid parameter in the Signature-Input header.

crv.description: Elliptic curve. REQUIRED when kty is EC.

x.description: X coordinate (base64url). REQUIRED for EC keys.

y.description: Y coordinate (base64url). REQUIRED for EC keys.

alg.description: Algorithm. ES256 is RECOMMENDED. Implementations MUST support ES256.

ServiceBinding.title: ServiceBinding
ServiceBinding.description: A transport-specific binding for a USP service endpoint, as declared in a profile services registry.

version.description: Protocol version implemented at this endpoint (YYYY-MM-DD).

endpoint.description: Base URL of the endpoint. REQUIRED for rest, mcp, and a2a transports.

schema.description: URL to the machine-readable schema (OpenAPI or OpenRPC).

CapabilityEntry.title: CapabilityEntry
CapabilityEntry.description: Declares support for a specific version of a USP capability, as listed in a profile capabilities registry.

spec.description: URL to the capability specification. RECOMMENDED in profiles.

schema.description: URL to the capability JSON Schema. RECOMMENDED in profiles.

extends.description: Base capability name(s) this capability extends, in reverse-domain format.

BusinessProfile.title: BusinessProfile
BusinessProfile.description: The USP business profile document. MUST be published at /.well-known/usp over HTTPS with Cache-Control: public, max-age>=60 and no redirects.

version.description: USP protocol version implemented by this business (YYYY-MM-DD).

services.description: Service endpoint registry. Keys are reverse-domain service names; values are arrays of ServiceBinding.

capabilities.description: Capability registry. Keys are reverse-domain capability names; values are arrays of CapabilityEntry.

checkout_systems.description: OPTIONAL. Checkout systems integrated for paid bookings. Omit for free or pay-at-service services.

supported_versions.description: OPTIONAL. Backward-compatibility map. Keys are older protocol versions (YYYY-MM-DD); values are URIs to version-specific profiles.

signing_keys.description: CONDITIONAL. Public keys for webhook signature verification. MUST be present when the business sends signed webhooks. See Section 10.1.1.

PlatformProfile.title: PlatformProfile
PlatformProfile.description: The USP platform profile document. Published at a stable HTTPS URI advertised via the USP-Agent header (REST) or _meta.usp.profile field (MCP).

version.description: The highest USP protocol version this platform supports (YYYY-MM-DD).

capabilities.description: Capabilities the platform can consume. Same format as business profile.

example.title: Bad Request
example.detail: Malformed JSON or missing required fields

example.title: Unauthorized
example.detail: Authentication credentials are missing or invalid

example.title: Not Found
example.detail: The requested resource does not exist

example.title: Conflict
example.detail: Idempotency key was previously used with different parameters

example.title: Forbidden
example.detail: The platform profile URL is not in the business's pre-approved allowlist

example.title: Failed Dependency
example.detail: Business profile could not be fetched

BusyBlock.title: BusyBlock
BusyBlock.description: An opaque busy time block from a buyer's calendar. Contains only start and end times. Implementations MUST NOT include event details (titles, descriptions, attendees, locations). Part of the platform-scoped calendar free/busy extension (dev.usp.platform.calendar_freebusy).

start.description: RFC 3339 start of the busy period.

end.description: RFC 3339 end of the busy period.

BuyerFreeBusy.title: BuyerFreeBusy
BuyerFreeBusy.description: Aggregated free/busy data for a buyer across one or more calendar providers. The platform queries the buyer's calendar provider(s) and merges the results into a single set of busy blocks. Part of the platform-scoped calendar free/busy extension (dev.usp.platform.calendar_freebusy).

buyer_ref.description: Opaque platform-generated buyer correlation ID. MUST NOT contain personally identifiable information.

timezone.description: IANA timezone identifier for the buyer (e.g., America/New_York).

queried_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp of when the free/busy data was fetched from the calendar provider. Used as a freshness indicator for caching.

busy_blocks.description: Array of busy time blocks merged across all connected calendar providers. An empty array means the buyer has no calendar conflicts in the queried range.

query.description: Free-text search query across service names, descriptions, and categories. When present, the business SHOULD rank results by relevance. Businesses that do not support search MUST ignore this field (not return an error). Aligns with UCP catalog_search.

filters.description: Filter criteria to narrow results. All specified filters combine with AND logic.

type.description: Service vertical to filter by (e.g., appointment, group, reservation).

category_id.description: Single category ID to filter by. Shorthand for categories with one value. If both category_id and categories are provided, categories takes precedence.

categories.description: Category IDs to filter by (OR logic — matches services in any listed category). Aligns with UCP catalog_search filters.

location_id.description: Location ID to filter by (for multi-location businesses).

price.description: Price range filter in minor currency units. Currency determined by context.currency or the business's default currency.

min.description: Minimum price in minor currency units (e.g., 5000 = $50.00).

max.description: Maximum price in minor currency units (e.g., 15000 = $150.00).

context.description: Buyer locale and intent signals for relevance, localization, and personalization. Aligns with UCP context pattern. Businesses SHOULD use context when available and MUST ignore unrecognized fields without error.

address_country.description: Buyer's country (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, e.g., US). Hint for market context.

address_region.description: Region within the country (e.g., California). Optional localization hint.

postal_code.description: Postal code (e.g., 94043). Optional regional refinement hint.

coordinates.description: Buyer's geographic coordinates for proximity-based ranking. Higher-resolution than postal code; location_id filter supersedes for multi-location businesses.

language.description: Preferred language (IETF BCP 47, e.g., en, fr-CA). Business MAY return content in a different language if unavailable.

currency.description: Preferred currency (ISO 4217, e.g., USD, EUR). Used as denomination for price filter values. Response prices include explicit currency.

intent.description: Free-text description of the buyer's intent (e.g., 'looking for a relaxing spa treatment'). Informs relevance and recommendations.

messages.description: Optional errors, warnings, or informational messages about the response (e.g., partial results, filter feedback, service-level notices).
Optional errors, warnings, or informational messages about the service (e.g., temporarily suspended, pricing provisional).

post.description: Returns full service objects for a batch of service IDs. Analogous to UCP catalog_lookup. Designed for hydrating multiple service references in a single request.

ids.description: Service IDs to look up. Businesses MUST accept at least 50 IDs. Duplicates are silently deduplicated.

context.description: Buyer locale and intent signals for localization of returned service content. Same definition as on POST /services/list. Businesses MUST ignore unrecognized fields without error.

coordinates.description: Buyer's geographic coordinates for proximity context.

language.description: Preferred language (IETF BCP 47, e.g., en, fr-CA).

200.description: Lookup results. May contain fewer services than requested IDs if some IDs were not found.

services.description: Services matching the requested IDs. May contain fewer items than requested if some IDs were not found. Unordered.

messages.description: Errors, warnings, or informational messages about the lookup (e.g., service_not_found for unresolved IDs).

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor from a previous feed response's next_cursor field. Omit on the first request.

data.description: Full service object for updated state; object containing only id for deleted state.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor to pass on the next request. Null when no more pages.

messages.description: Optional errors, warnings, or informational messages about the feed response (e.g., partial results due to degraded feed status).

post.description: Returns available time slots for a service within a date range. Platforms SHOULD query at most 7 calendar days per request. Businesses MAY reject wider ranges with HTTP 422 and error code range_too_wide. Slots are returned in ascending start order. See Section 9.1.2 of the specification for pagination semantics.

start_date.description: Start of range (RFC 3339 date or datetime).

end_date.description: End of range (RFC 3339 date or datetime).

timezone.description: IANA timezone. Defaults to business timezone.

resource_id.description: Preferred resource. If provided, only slots where this resource is available are returned.

party_size.description: Number of participants. For group/reservation types, only slots with sufficient remaining capacity are returned.

location_id.description: Location filter. Only slots at this location are returned. Applies to multi-location businesses.

locale.description: BCP 47 language tag (e.g., en-US). When provided, the business SHOULD return human-readable content (resource names, slot labels, opening_hours day names) in the requested locale.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response. Omit on the first request. See Section 9.1.2 of the specification.

limit.description: Requested page size. Businesses MAY apply a lower or upper cap.

opening_hours.description: Regular business hours for the queried period. Special closures are reflected by the absence of slots, not by this field.

day_of_week.description: Days this entry applies to. Lowercase English day names: monday, tuesday, wednesday, thursday, friday, saturday, sunday.

opens.description: Opening time in HH:MM 24-hour format (local business time).

closes.description: Closing time in HH:MM 24-hour format (local business time). 00:00 or 24:00 indicates midnight (end of day).

messages.description: Optional informational or warning messages about the result set (e.g., reduced availability due to staff absence, holiday hours in effect).

post.description: Creates a temporary hold on a time slot. Requires the business to advertise holds: true in the dev.usp.services.availability capability.

spots.description: Number of spots to hold. For group/reservation types.

200.description: Hold created or business outcome error

delete.description: Explicitly releases a hold before it expires. Requires the business to advertise holds: true in the dev.usp.services.availability capability.

hold_id.description: Hold ID from a prior hold operation. Present only when the business supports holds (holds: true on the availability capability). When provided, the business converts the hold to a booking.

recipient.description: The person receiving the service, when different from the buyer. When absent, the buyer is the recipient.

post_payment_return_request.description: Applicable when checkout_systems: redirect is in use. The platform SHOULD always include this field on the redirect checkout path — without it, the platform has no way to predict where the buyer will land after payment or cancellation.

recipient.description: The person receiving the service, when different from the buyer.

slot_id.description: The new slot to reschedule to.

hold_id.description: Hold ID for the new slot. Present only when the business supports holds (holds: true on the availability capability).

provider.description: Payment provider identifier (e.g. stripe, adyen, paypal). Informational.

transaction_id.description: Transaction identifier from the payment provider.

amount_paid.description: Amount paid in minor currency units.

order_reference.description: External order identifier from the checkout system.

slot_id.description: Specific slot to waitlist for, if applicable.

preferred_slots.description: Preferred time windows. If omitted, the buyer accepts any available slot.

hold_id.description: Hold ID for the offered slot, if already held.

usp_profile_url.description: The business's /.well-known/usp profile URL. Must be reachable and return a valid USP profile.

min.description: Minimum price in minor currency units.

max.description: Maximum price in minor currency units.

get.description: Returns the USP business profile document. Published at the well-known URI path. Platforms fetch this document to discover endpoints, negotiate capabilities, determine supported checkout systems, and obtain webhook verification keys. MUST be served over HTTPS with Cache-Control: public, max-age>=60 and no redirects.

Cache-Control.description: MUST include public and max-age>=60. Example: public, max-age=300
